product: Pocket Beacon (fictional BLE item finder, toolkit proof of concept)

battery.type: CR2032 Li-MnO2 primary coin cell, 20.0 x 3.2 mm, round
battery.evidence: [verified: DigiKey listing Panasonic CR2032 225 mAh, 2026-11-08] rated; usable 0.85 [verified: TI SWRA349 Fig. 8/9, worst vendor with a buffer capacitor delivered 181 of 220 mAh = 82 % to 2.0 V under 15-30 mA pulses]; eol 0.97 [estimate: ~1 %/year self-discharge, Energizer CR2032 datasheet UltimateCR2032EU0920, x 3 years shelf + use]

VBAT.evidence: [estimate: CR2032 open-circuit 3.0-3.3 V fresh, 2.0 V end-of-life cutoff (Energizer and SWRA349 test cutoff); max_ma = REQ-005 ring target]

modes.name: connected_idle
modes.note: phone in range: BLE connection, 1000 ms interval, peripheral latency 1 (one event per 2 s)

modes.name: adv_slow
modes.note: phone away: connectable advertising every 1285 ms (Apple accessory guideline value), 3 channels, 0 dBm

modes.name: adv_fast
modes.note: 20 ms advertising for 30 s after each disconnect or button press, 4 times per day = 120 s/day

modes.name: app_active
modes.note: app open in the foreground: 30 ms connection interval with GATT traffic, 60 s/day

modes.name: ring
modes.note: 10 rings x 12 s per month = 3.95 s/day; piezo driver 3x mode; LED off while ringing in 3x mode

modes.name: button_led
modes.note: 3 presses/day, 100 ms LED flash + wake processing

parts.name: BLE SoC CC2340R52 (incl. RF, DC/DC on)
parts.evidence: [estimate: event charge built from verified SWRS272F 7.9/7.10 figures (TX 0 dBm 5.1 mA, RX 5.3 mA, idle 0.8 mA, active 2.6 mA, standby 0.74 uA with LFXT): advertising event 10.3 uC (3 x [TX 0.30 ms + RX 0.20 ms + hop 0.15 ms] + 1.2 ms pre/post at 1.5 mA), connection event 3.6 uC; ring = idle 0.8 mA with timer PWM + connection events]

parts.name: Piezo driver PAM8904EGPR
parts.evidence: [verified: Diodes DS41667 Rev 4-2, IDD 3x differential 14.2 mA typ, ISD 8 nA typ, read by specs stage 2026-11-08]

parts.name: Amber status LED + 330 ohm (D-024)
parts.evidence: [estimate: (3.0 V - 1.85 V Vf at 3.5 mA) / 330 ohm; Vf about 1.75 V at 1 mA per F-207]

parts.name: Board leakage: MLCC insulation (78 uF on VBAT after D-022), ESD diode, FET, flux residue
parts.evidence: [estimate: X5R insulation spec >= 500 MOhm*uF gives <= 0.47 uA worst case for 78 uF at 3 V, typical 10-100x lower; ESD diode and flux about 0.1 uA; 0.3 uA planned]
